Tumor Location and Cortical involvement show a frontal_lobe-cortex lesion, a common location/pattern for IDH-mutant diffuse glioma. Enhancement Quality, ET Volume (mL), Proportion Enhancing, NCR Volume (mL), and Proportion Necrosis show no enhancement, no enhancing tumor, no necrotic/non-enhancing core, and no necrosis, which argues against the more typical aggressive IDH-wildtype glioblastoma imaging phenotype. Deep WM invasion is absent, also less suggestive of an infiltrative high-grade IDH-wildtype pattern. Evidence against this conclusion is that T2-FLAIR Mismatch Present is 0.0 with only a T2-FLAIR Mismatch Score of 0.4, so a specific imaging sign associated with IDH-mutant astrocytoma is not present; Side of Tumor Epicenter is listed as Midline, which is less classic for a lateral frontal IDH-mutant diffuse glioma. Overall, the young age and nonenhancing frontal cortical phenotype outweigh these limitations, so the best estimate is IDH-mutant.
